ships.name: The Turncoat
ships.desc: A stolen Rebuff patrol cutter. Tough hull, ion cannon, and a crew with a lot to prove.

ships.name: The Whistleblower
ships.desc: A Rebuff intelligence ship. Hacking and cloaking, but only one gun.

weapons.name: Patrol Ion
weapons.desc: Standard Rebuff patrol ion cannon. Two bolts to strip shields.

events.text: A Rebuff patrol hails you, puzzled. "Your ship is on our register, but your transponder says Fedoration."

success.text: "Happens all the time." They wave you through.

effect.text: One of their crew likes it so much she jumps ship to join you.

events.text: An old Rebuff comrade of your first officer is stationed here, bored on a supply depot.

effect.text: A crate of missiles falls off the back of the depot.

success.text: "I thought you'd never ask." They bring their tools.
